messages:
alex chen: Hey @people-ops - planning to be in Tallinn for ~4 months starting 2024-06-15 to join my partner. Quick Qs: 1) Is WFH stipend prorated for ~4 months? 2) Payroll/tax nexus risk for Redwood? 3) Can we ship my company laptop there (VAT/customs)? 4) Benefits continuity (medical/pension) while away. Who do I file with? :slightly_smiling_face:
maya (people-ops): Thanks for the heads-up! Short answers: submit a temporary-homebase request, stipend is prorated monthly, payroll/legal need to check nexus, shipping okay via approved vendor, benefits usually continue but confirm specifics. Form: https://intranet.redwood/work-remote/temporary-homebase
alex chen: Done - I just submitted the form and attached dates + partner permit PDF. Anything else you need?
sanjay (payroll): @alex chen please add your temporary address in Tallinn, exact start/end dates, and whether you'll remain on USD payroll. We'll do a payroll nexus check. Note: stays under ~90 days often safe for payroll in many countries, but Estonia at ~120 days could be fuzzy. Don't change bank details until we confirm.
nora (legal): Looping in legal: Estonian tax residency is typically 183+ days but other factors (permanent establishment, local clients) matter. We'll open ticket with our external tax advisor. Please confirm day-to-day duties (internal infra vs client work) and whether you'll be meeting customers locally.
maya (people-ops): For the stipend: policy in the form. We prorate monthly; partial months by calendar days. Equipment shipping: choose "international ship" in the form so we route to our vendor (they handle PO/VAT where possible). Keep receipts for internet or coworking expenses if you plan to expense them.
hr-bot: AUTOMATED REMINDER: Temporary homebase requests must be submitted >=15 business days before travel. Required: partner visa/permit OR proof of purpose, exact dates, temporary address. https://intranet.redwood/forms/temp-remote
alex chen: Follow-ups: 1) Is VAT/customs reimbursable if vendor can't handle it? 2) If tax partner flags a cutover, how quickly would Redwood decide so I can sign a lease?
sanjay (payroll): Usually vendor-handled VAT/customs are covered on corporate purchases. If you personally import and submit expense, pre-approval required. If tax partner flags employer obligations, payroll needs ~2 pay cycles to implement changes; legal's input comes first (~3-5 business days). We'll aim to give an explicit decision window.
nora (legal): We're opening the advisory ticket now. To speed review, provide a one-line summary of your role while abroad (e.g., "core infra, no client-facing work") and confirm no in-person recruiting or customer meetings planned. If any client-facing activity, risk increases.
alex chen: Role summary: core infra work only, no planned client meetings or local recruiting. I'll be available during PST overlap. OK to route shipping via vendor. Thanks! :raised_hands:
maya (people-ops): Great, that's helpful. Next steps: 1) legal opens ticket with tax advisor (nora) 2) payroll runs nexus check (sanjay) 3) people-ops confirms stipend proration & shipping (me). We'll update you here by EOD or as soon as we have answers. If you need to book housing early, DM me and we can give a provisional note but it's at your risk until tax/payroll confirm.
alex chen: Sounds good - I'll wait for confirmation before signing lease. Will update the form if plans change. :thumbsup:
